say:3:1321758001:1.text: Apologies, everyone. The ball hasn't been set up yet. Please return later.
say:3:1321758001:1.source_cn: 非常抱歉，各位大人，舞会还没有布置好，请过一会儿再来吧。

say:4:1321758002:1.text: It's a real ball! Is Miss Lydia actually planning to imitate every single event from the Snowspire Festival?
say:4:1321758002:1.source_cn: 居然真的是舞会！莉娅女士准备把冬日祭典的每个活动都复刻...

say:5:1321758003:1.text: But with Princess Yolena's health, can she even dance...?
say:5:1321758003:1.source_cn: 不过，以亚莲娜公主的身体状况，她可以跳舞吗……？

say:8:1321758004:1.text: Perhaps, in this illusion, Her Highness' condition has improved...
say:8:1321758004:1.source_cn: 也许在幻境里，亚莲娜公主的病情已经好转了……

say:13:1321758005:1.text: The ball won't begin when all the other activities have ended. Why don't we go to the <style="highlight">audience chamber</style> first, Magister?
say:13:1321758005:1.source_cn: 舞会应该要等到其他项目都结束后才会开始。魔法师大人，不...
